en: I believe we've met before...
Thank you very much. Right away,
I'll bring your coffee.
Please, have another cup.
Hello. Welcome.
We got some especially fine beans in today.
And dirt cheap, too... eh?
If you're after hidden gems from the harbor,
you could try the warehouse by the docks.
It's well worth a look.
Hello,

en: Welcome.
note: Maitz (86960) variant 'Welcome, ' so it reads 'Welcome, NAME.'

en: The hidden-gem warehouse I told you about,
did you go and see it?
<I went>
<I'm not going>
You got to see some rare things, didn't you?
I recommend you go and see it
at least once.
Hey, welcome.
has really become

en: one of my regulars, huh?
When it comes to coffee, aroma is everything.
Mine is always freshly ground.
It's been ages since anyone visited my home.
The shop gets customers every day, though.
If you'd like, stop by Café Jahn.
note: Ends with a period; #1528 (slice 019) follows it in msg 59141

en: Please do. It's my cafe.
A cafe, hm...
A coffee now and then would do no harm.
Next time, at Café Jahn,
note: Comma ending; #1531 (slice 019) must follow 'Next time, at Café Jahn,'

en: let's meet.
is there something I can do for you?
Well, well,
To think you'd come all this way to see me.
I know! You want some coffee, right?
No good, I'm afraid. You have to come to the shop during business hours.
Say, if you've got nothing to do right now,
how about a cup of coffee?
If you want to flirt, talk to a woman.
I may not look it, but I am a man.
Oh, my apologies. I didn't mean it that way.
You see, I run a cafe.
It has the same name as me: Jahn.
Hmm, is that so?
It's true, all right.
Well then, I'll be waiting.
I'll be waiting, so do come by!
did you like the coffee?
, is that you?
note: Jahn (58741) variant 'NAME! Well, hello there.'; others 'NAME, is that you?' (Stanberg, Hugo)

en: When you're here, other customers flock in.
Do you know Café Jahn?
Stop by the shop again sometime.
have been injured, you know.
note: Continues #1431 (slice 017), which must end before 'have been injured'

en: What on earth is going on?
Why... what a beautiful person.
I think I'll give you some special service.
<I may not look it, but I'm a man!>
<Then I'll take that service>
I see. A man, is it?
note: No used_in; Jahn's reply to <I may not look it...>

en: I don't mind, even so!
Just kidding.
No, I'm joking. Anyway, man or woman,
a glamorous visitor brings in customers,
and that makes me happy.
Here, drink up. It's my special coffee.
note: Reply to <Then I'll take that service>

en: No, I know perfectly well you're a man.
But when someone glamorous comes by,
I get more customers, and I'm happy.
Huh, you're the one I met before...
So you really did come.
I'll get your coffee ready right away.
When someone glamorous like you comes by,
I get more customers, and I'm happy.
Care for another cup before you go?
Welcome. You came at a good time.
We got some especially fine beans in today.
If you're after hidden gems from the harbor,
you could try the warehouse by the docks.
